decisions.reason: The candidate already records the connector-specific clauses from message 842. The antenna orientation and keepout are independently owned by the source Requirement and do not change the connector-layout attributes.
Antenna orientation and keepout on the integrated board do not change the legacy main board's four-layer stack requirement.

The source Event changes ESP32 antenna orientation and clearance, not the independently tracked battery-connector accessibility rules. The J_BAT clause is already represented by the integrated-board connector-layout Requirement.
The legacy interboard-alignment requirement was already rendered inapplicable by the single-board architecture; the antenna constraint does not further change its retained removal facts.
The antenna constraint assumes the existing integrated-board topology but does not change the architecture or board count.
The integrated-board antenna orientation and keepout do not necessarily alter the legacy main-board dimensions or routing-fit state.
The antenna placement constraint does not change the cost objective, component-selection policy, integrated architecture, or connector-reduction strategy.
ESP32 antenna orientation and RF keepout do not change the I2C speed, pull-ups, series resistors, topology, or integrated-board location.

The antenna constraint does not change USB enumeration, programming behavior, data lines, connector sourceability, or port role. USB-C edge placement is separately represented by the connector-layout Requirement.
Facing the antenna away from the battery is a mechanical and RF constraint and does not alter the battery's electrical protection requirements.
The antenna constraint does not change the sensor fanout role, external-module connector inventory, consolidation policy, or absence of interboard connectors.

The antenna orientation and keepout do not change the e-paper backlight circuit or its electrical and control attributes. Display-connector grouping is independently represented by the connector-layout Requirement.
